verdict.rationale: Pigment documents several first-party ways to run the product in natural language. The Modeler Agent builds and maintains planning models from natural-language intent, and the Analyst Agent builds reports from simple conversations. Through its official MCP server, users can also build and edit models and ask business questions from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Codex, with role-scoped access. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work as claimed, and in-depth documentation (beyond marketing pages) of which operations natural language can perform and its limits.
